def is_costas(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    for d in range(1, n):
        diffs = set()
        for i in range(n - d):
            diff = arr[i + d] - arr[i]
            if diff in diffs:
                return False
            diffs.add(diff)
    return True

arr = [1, 7, 8, 11, 3, 13, 9, 14, 12, 6, 5, 2, 10, 0, 4]

print("Max:", max(arr))
